audit.note: Model reviewed extracted evidence; this is not independent ground truth.

design_claim.text: Drawing shows orange hollow-block masonry inside the insulation line.

photo_claim.text: Photo shows reddish hollow blocks with rectangular voids behind pink board.

findings.correspondence_basis: Both show hollow clay blocks directly behind the pink insulation in the same wall sequence.
findings.justification: Block voids and stacking visible in both sources align in position behind insulation. Finish color difference is rendering style, not construction difference.
limitations: Drawing is schematic section, photo is perspective cutaway

design_claim.text: Drawing shows pink dotted insulation layer outside masonry and concrete.

photo_claim.text: Photo shows thick pink beaded insulation board outside the blocks.

findings.correspondence_basis: Both show continuous pink beaded board applied externally over masonry.
findings.justification: Position, continuity and pink beaded depiction correspond to the pink board in the photo. Product brand or grade cannot be confirmed visually.
limitations: Material grade and adhesive cannot be verified from images

design_claim.text: Drawing shows dowel symbols fixing insulation to masonry and slab.

photo_claim.text: Photo shows metal dowel with round plate through pink board.

findings.correspondence_basis: Both show dowel anchors passing through insulation into substrate with plate on insulation face.
findings.justification: Fixing path through insulation and washer/plate location correspond. Exact dowel type not distinguishable beyond observed shape.

design_claim.text: Drawing shows thin mesh and coat layers outside the pink insulation.

photo_claim.text: Photo shows white grid mesh over the pink board face.

findings.correspondence_basis: Both show white grid mesh on outer face of pink insulation under outer coats.
findings.justification: Mesh position on insulation outer face matches in both. Number of coats not countable from photo.

design_claim.text: Drawing shows grey and finish layers outside mesh.

photo_claim.text: Photo shows grey coat with beige finish outside mesh.

findings.correspondence_basis: Both show grey base plus light finish over mesh, preserving same outward sequence.
findings.justification: Layer order insulation-mesh-grey-finish is visible in both. Texture names cannot be proven from photo alone.
limitations: Render product names on drawing not visually verifiable

design_claim.text: Drawing shows window frame below slab and perforated drip profile detail.

photo_claim.text: Photo shows white window profiles and perforated metal angle at slab edge.

findings.correspondence_basis: Both show window frames meeting slab with perforated angle/profile at insulation base.
findings.justification: White frame sections above and below concrete and perforated metal angle correspond in location. Functional ventilation claim distinguished from observed shape.

design_claim.text: Drawing annotates bonding layer as BAUMIT Лепило WDVS Kleber on the brick wall build-up.

photo_claim.text: Photo does not show a distinct adhesive bonding layer between brick masonry and pink insulation; the brick-to-insulation interface is tight with no legible adhesive bed or marking.

findings.correspondence_basis: No distinct bonding layer or product marking is resolvable at the brick-insulation interface in photo regions; correspondence to branded adhesive cannot be confirmed visually.
findings.justification: Photo shows brick masonry F1-F4 directly abutting pink insulation G1-G4 with no exposed adhesive bed. Thin bonding layer, if present, is concealed at the contact interface and no text, colour or texture identifying BAUMIT WDVS Kleber is legible.
limitations: Product qualifier spelling transliterated from low-resolution annotation; exact punctuation uncertain.
Adhesive layer concealed behind insulation in photo; thin layer not resolvable at this resolution.
Brand/product name cannot be verified from photo alone.

design_claim.text: Drawing annotates thermal insulation as BAUMIT EPS-F boards, with vertical BAUMIT EPS-F shown at concrete slab edge.

photo_claim.text: Photo shows continuous pink beaded insulation boards applied over the brick wall and continuing vertically past the concrete slab edge.

findings.correspondence_basis: Continuous board-form insulation is clearly visible over the brick wall and continuing vertically past the concrete slab edge, matching the expected location/extent of EPS-F in the design.
findings.justification: Photo G1-G8 shows pink beaded insulation boards in a continuous vertical layer over brick F1-F4 and over slab-edge zone F6-G8. Board joints and beaded EPS texture are visible. Brand and EPS-F designation are not legible, but presence, board form and location correspond.
limitations: Board thickness dimension at top edge not reliably legible and not stated.
Brand BAUMIT and EPS-F type not legible in photo; colour appears pink.
No metric thickness inferred.

design_claim.text: Drawing annotates outer render build-up to include BAUMIT putty/shpaklovka layer and BAUMIT glass-textile mesh.

photo_claim.text: Photo shows white glass-textile mesh over pink insulation along full height with grey base-coat/render partly covering it and exposed mesh at side and lower termination.

findings.correspondence_basis: White woven mesh and grey render coat over insulation are directly visible in photo side and front faces, matching the expected mesh-reinforced base-coat build-up.
findings.justification: Photo H1-H9 shows white glass-textile grid mesh over pink insulation, partially embedded with mesh still exposed. Grey base-coat/render is visible at H6-I8 over and beside mesh, and mesh wraps the lower termination G9-H9. Layout corresponds to reinforced outer render.
limitations: Second word of putty product name not fully certain at this resolution; not quoted verbatim beyond BAUMIT Shpaklovka.
Brand of putty/mesh not legible in photo; putty vs base-coat cannot be separated visually where covered.

design_claim.text: Drawing annotates finish layers as BAUMIT Universal primer and BAUMIT structural plaster.

photo_claim.text: Photo shows light beige textured outer finish over grey base coat on the external face; a separate Universal primer layer is not visually distinguishable.

findings.correspondence_basis: Outer textured finish is visible, but a separate thin primer layer cannot be isolated visually and no product names are legible, so full primer-plus-finish correspondence is not confirmable.
findings.justification: Photo I1-I9 shows light beige textured outer finish over grey base. Finish presence and exterior position correspond. Primer as a distinct layer is not visually separable from finish/base and no labels for Universal primer or structural plaster are visible.
limitations: Color, grain size and application thickness not annotated in legible region.
Thin primer coat not visually distinguishable from finish in photo.
Brand/product names not verifiable from photo.

design_claim.text: Drawing annotates BAUMIT dowel fixing through insulation into brick masonry and into concrete slab edge.

photo_claim.text: Photo shows metallic disc-type mechanical fixing with shank penetrating the pink insulation at slab-edge level.

findings.correspondence_basis: Disc-type mechanical fixing penetrating the insulation is clearly visible at slab-edge level in photo, matching expected dowel-through-insulation detail.
findings.justification: Photo F6-H8 shows metallic fixing with circular plate/washer and threaded shank driven through pink insulation G6-G7. Position at slab-edge insulation corresponds to dowel-through-insulation intent. Embedment substrate and brand are not visible.
limitations: Dowel type, length, spacing and number per m2 not legible in supplied views.
Fixing embedment into masonry/slab concealed by insulation/concrete; brand BAUMIT not visible.
Only one fixing visible in this cut view; system spacing cannot be assessed.

design_claim.text: Drawing annotates Zatvaryasht vodokapvasht profil and BAUMIT window profile Standard at the slab to window opening junction, with enlarged details at bottom of sheet.

photo_claim.text: Photo shows perforated metal profiles with mesh and window/sill profiles at the concrete slab to lower window junction.

findings.correspondence_basis: Perforated profiles and window/sill profiles are visible at the concrete slab to lower-window junction, matching the expected profile location at the slab-window opening.
findings.justification: Photo E8-G9 shows perforated metal angle/drip-type profiles with round holes at the slab to lower-window junction, with mesh wrapping and insulation termination. Photo E5-F6 shows white window sill/profile above slab. Presence and junction location correspond to annotated profiles; exact profile names, dimensions and material not legible.
limitations: Small leader text in circular details at bottom is not reliably legible; profile dimensions and material not stated.
Exact profile identities/names cannot be distinguished visually; brand not visible.
